description: Corrected the verdict-reported date from "Thursday 24 Sept 2026" (an estimate in early planning notes) to Friday 25 September 2026, based on dated coverage from CNN, Al Jazeera and Bloomberg, and David Ornstein's own timestamped post on X.

Removed an unverifiable claim that Manchester City spent "~€1.44bn on players 2009–2018" per a cited SportBible article; no such article could be located. A sourced alternative (£1.243bn across 76 signings over the same period, reported by Goal.com) was found and noted for future use, but was not substituted automatically.

Corrected City Football Group's club list on The Money page: an early research note listed Yokohama F. Marinos and Mumbai City as current CFG clubs. Both have since been divested (Mumbai City reported December 2025; Yokohama F. Marinos reported June 2026) and are now listed as former clubs.
